name: SparkTest SaaS Cloud
description: A Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) monorepo for SparkTest with multi-tenancy, built with modern technologies

architecture.frontend: Next.js 14 with TypeScript and App Router

apps/saas/backend/.description: Rust backend with Axum web framework

SaasTestDefinition.description: Test code with metadata for execution, with SaaS multi-tenancy support

SaasTestRun.description: Execution instance of a test definition with organizational context

SaasExecutor.description: Test execution environment with organizational ownership

SaasTestSuite.description: Collection of test definitions with organizational scope

Organization.description: Multi-tenant organization entity for SaaS model

naming_conventions.rust: snake_case for functions and variables, PascalCase for types and structs
naming_conventions.typescript: camelCase for functions and variables, PascalCase for types and components
naming_conventions.files: kebab-case for file names, except React components (PascalCase)

api_routes.multi_tenancy: Filtered by user_id and organization_id where applicable

error_handling.typescript: try-catch blocks with proper error types

state_management.frontend: React state with StorageService abstraction (local/API modes)
state_management.backend: Arc<Mutex<>> for shared state (temporary), PostgreSQL for future persistence
state_management.storage_service: Abstraction layer supporting both local storage and API modes

multi_tenancy.entity_filtering: All SaaS entities include user_id and organization_id

tools.linting: ESLint for TypeScript, Clippy for Rust
tools.formatting: Prettier for TypeScript, rustfmt for Rust
tools.bundling: Next.js built-in for frontend, Cargo for backend

frontend.ui: @radix-ui/* (accordion, dialog, dropdown-menu, label, select, tabs, toast)

context.domain: Multi-tenant SaaS test execution platform for modern developers
context.target_users: Development teams and organizations needing to run tests in various languages
key_features: Comprehensive CRUD operations for test definitions, runs, executors, and suites
Multi-language test execution support (JavaScript, Python, Rust)
Dual storage modes: local storage and API backend
Monorepo architecture with shared TypeScript types
Type safety across TypeScript and Rust boundaries
Modern UI with Radix components and Tailwind CSS
context.inspiration: Based on the open-source SparkTest project design principles, enhanced for SaaS deployment
